_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: elderly / retirement era ↔ youthful physical description
axes.rationale: All three lenses agree on the negative end: 194/195/WWII, retirement, retirees and dementia mark old age and birth decades. The positive end is youth and physical traits, with girls/boys/adolescent in the Jacobian lens and tall/handsome/lean in the logit and tuned lenses.

axes.label: young offspring (puppies, toddlers) ↔ married middle-aged adult
axes.rationale: Three lenses agree on the positive end: married/marriage/divorced, birth years 196/197/198, and ages 33/35 point to adult marital life stage. The negative end is clear only in the Jacobian lens (puppies, toddlers, youngsters, kittens); the logit and tuned negatives are noise.

axes.label: teenagers ↔ pets / dog age
axes.rationale: The negative end is consistent across lenses: teenagers, teens, youth and adolescents in the Jacobian lens, with teens/teen/teenager also appearing in the tuned and logit lenses. The positive end is clear only in the Jacobian lens (dogs, pets, veterinary, canine); the other lenses mostly give fragments plus some retirement tokens.
